postliminium.translation: n. 战后公民资格或财产的恢复权

postliminy.definition:
n. The return to his own country, and his former
   privileges, of a person who had gone to sojourn in a foreign country,
   or had been banished, or taken by an enemy.
n. The right by virtue of which persons and things taken
   by an enemy in war are restored to their former state when coming again
   under the power of the nation to which they belonged.
postliminy.translation: n. 战后公民资格或财产的恢复权

postliterate.translation: a. 文字后的,采用电子传媒的

postlude.definition: n. a voluntary played at the end of a religious service
